title: The War After 1946
subtitle: 战争与和平 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 战争与和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）
meta: 主题语境：战争与和平（历史社会与文化·战争与和平）　|　核心词汇：war　|　正文 328 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 war 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: My grandfather went to the ① war in 1939 and came back in 1946 and never said a word about it, which my grandmother said was not silence but a different language. He had ② gone to war at nineteen, and he said later that the hardest part was not the fighting but the eleven months of waiting for it to begin, and no war, he said, ends when the paper says it does.

By 1942 the whole street was ③ at war with the dark: blackout cloth on eleven windows, a warden who came round at nine, and my grandmother's brother fined twice. In 1948 the county declared a ④ war on the rats in the river bank, and eleven men were paid eleven shillings a day to walk it, and my grandfather was one of them.

In 1953 my grandmother ⑤ declared war on the woman next door, over a hedge, and the ⑥ war lasted thirty-one years; neither of them ever said what it had been about, and my mother says a family at war is a family with too much time and not enough money.

In 1944, in the fifth year of the ⑦ war, he was in a town eleven miles from where he had been born, and he said the oddest thing about it was that he could hear the church bell. The ⑧ war of words in the village — the letters in the paper every week about the memorial — went on until 1975, when both men who wrote them died, eleven weeks apart.

The ⑨ war he never discussed, and which I have read about since, took eleven million people and gave him a cough that lasted until 1989, and the war was the only thing he never wrote about. The ⑩ war he actually fought after 1946, and he did fight one, was against the damp in eleven council houses: he wrote to the council about it every year for thirty-one years, and he won two of them.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 战争（武装冲突）
B. n. 战争状态；交战时期
C. n. （对贫困、灾害、疾病等的）斗争；运动
D. n. （家庭、邻里间的）长期不和；争斗
E. 固定搭配：go to war 参战；开战
F. 固定搭配：at war (with ...)（与……）处于交战／对抗状态
G. 固定搭配：declare war on ... 向……宣战；向……开战
H. 固定搭配：a war of words 口水战；笔战

items.q: My grandfather went to the war in 1939
He had gone to war at nineteen
the whole street was at war with the dark
the county declared a war on the rats
my grandmother declared war on the woman
in the fifth year of the war
The war of words in the village
The war he actually fought after 1946

answers.why: the war 意为“战争”，祖父 1939 年上了战场，1946 年回来，一个字也没有提过。
go to war 意为“参战、开战”，他十九岁参战，后来他说最难的不是打仗，而是开战前那十一个月的等待。
at war with ... 意为“与……处于对抗状态”，到 1942 年整条街都在与黑暗对抗：十一扇窗户上的遮光布。
declare a war on ... 中的 war 意为“（对灾害等的）斗争、运动”，1948 年郡里向河岸的老鼠开战。
declare war on ... 意为“向……宣战、向……开战”，1953 年祖母为了一道树篱向隔壁的女人宣战。
the war 意为“长期的争斗、不和”，这场邻里间的争斗持续了三十一年。
the war 意为“战争状态、交战时期”，1944 年，也就是这场战争的第五年。
a war of words 意为“口水战、笔战”，村里关于纪念碑的笔战一直打到 1975 年。
the war 意为“战争”，他从不提起的那场战争夺走了一千一百万人。
the war 意为“（对……的）斗争”，1946 年后他真正在打的那一仗，是对十一户公房里的潮湿的斗争。
